name: appsflyer
description: AppsFlyer for Android and iOS: install attribution, in-app events and revenue, GDPR consent, OneLink deep links and deferred deep links. Protocols: analytics (events, purchases, progression, user id, consent) and links (deep links). Config: devKey, appId (iOS App Store id, digits only), debug, waitForATT (seconds the iOS SDK waits for the tracking prompt, default 60), oneLinkDomains [hosts].
